correctness.rationale: The normalized Weyl basis is W_(h,omega)/p; its output column is p^(-2) times A_g(h,omega) times the character psi(omega·a-b·h). Summing over p^4 output coordinates gives the claimed moduli with no extra factor of p. The conic has m points (split product fibers or nonsplit norm fibers). At nonzero h the intersection lies on h/2+h^perp. If Q(h)=0, h^perp is isotropic and there are no points; otherwise the perpendicular generator (d h_2,h_1) has norm -dQ(h), giving the stated character condition and one point exactly when Q(h)=4. Alternatively the involution (z,w) -> (-w,-z) pairs the ordered non-antipodal distinct differences while antipodes give m singletons; since intersections have size at most two this gives K=m(m-2)/2 and the exact rank. Cyclotomic irreducibility rules out cancellations when the size is 1, 2 or p±1. The nonzero relative displacement is a surjective frequency functional, giving p copies at each residue and the folded cosine multiplicities. For h=0 and nonzero omega, two completed Gauss squares give the multiplier chi(d) and argument -Q*(omega)/4 in the Kloosterman row, with m frequencies at each nonzero dual norm and (p-1)(1+chi(d)) nonzero isotropics. Rows add at coincidences. This is a statement about all matrices, not nonlinear phase retrieval. The checks/ scripts and outputs described at RESULT.md:90 are absent from the supplied package and were not replayed; the independent analytic reconstruction does not require them.
